title: Woodfire with Capital Ceramics (Delmar kiln)
host_org: Waterbrook Potters Studio & Capital Ceramic Supply
bring: CONE 10 clay pieces, food to share
commitment: One six-hour stoking shift during 10/22-10/24 firing
summary: Wood-fire your Cone 10 work in Capital Ceramic Supply's 2022 Delmar kiln. Participants commit to one six-hour stoking shift during the 24-30 hour firing, plus wadding and kiln prep beforehand. Cost is $125 per square foot of kiln space.
evidence_sentence: Waterbrook is teaming up with Capital Ceramic Supply to fire in their Delmar kiln, designed and built in 2022, with participants taking shifts stoking the fire.
evidence_quote: Waterbrook is teaming up with Capital Ceramic Supply again to take part in a community woodfiring at their Delmar kiln, designed and built in 2022.
source_quote: Woodfire has been moved to 10/22-10/24 due to move
